market_summary: All six instruments are exhibiting late New York session consolidation characterized by sub-1.0 RVOL (grey volume bars) and ATR band contraction. FX and metals have stalled in tight bear flags near session lows after earlier trend moves, while US100 and GBPUSD are compressing directly inside their session Value Areas around POC and EMA50 baselines. With dealer dampening active in gold, negative gamma capping US100, and no confirmed breakout momentum on volume, capital preservation mandates a strict HOLD across the board.
